## 5. Honest limits

| Limit | Consequence |
|---|---|
| Documentation binds payloads to endpoints only by **page proximity** | Some bindings will be wrong. Treat `confidence: medium` as a hypothesis, not a contract |
| Only **3** properties carry `[Required]` in the whole product | Mandatory-ness is *inferred* (present in every documented example), never asserted |
| `pam/PAM` supplies types, not routes | 58 of 70 catalogue controllers are absent from that snapshot |
| Swagger specs are **not** merged here | They describe a different surface (~6% name overlap) and need network access to fetch |
